descriptionChirho: Feminine noun מְנָת (construct form of מָנָה) meaning a portion, allotment, or share — especially of food, offerings, or spoils distributed among recipients. Used in contexts of cultic portions assigned to priests and Levites (2 Chr 31:3,4; Neh 12:44,47, 13:10) and shared food portions (Est 2:9, Ps 16:5). Multilingual evidence converges: eng portion/portions, spa porción/porciones, hin भाग, arb حِصَّة/أَنْصِبَة, kor 몫, swa sehemu. The singular construct and plural forms represent grammatical number variation of the same concept.
